summary: Change status of Paid WO to Paid - Foothills
reported_issue: Certain work orders are fully paid in ShopView but remain stuck on status 'invoiced' (should be 'paid'); users also cannot delete the payments to retry. Reported as very intermittent with unknown root cause; the ticket is a request to manually flip the status for Foothills' affected production WOs (S5-523, S5-2434, S5-2708, ... on app.shopview.com).
expected_after_fix: Affected WOs' status corrected to 'paid'; (underlying) a fully-paid WO should transition to 'paid' rather than remaining 'invoiced'.
steps_i_followed: Reviewed the ticket: it is a one-off manual production data-correction request referencing production WOs (app.shopview.com/S5-*) that do not exist on staging
On staging, inspected several 'invoiced' WOs' Finance tab (S9-24669, S9-24661, S9-24662) and captured the finance/invoice endpoints (/api/invoices/{invoiceId}/view)
Attempted to identify a fully-paid-but-stuck-invoiced WO to reproduce the condition
actual_now: The invoiced WOs examined on staging show normal non-zero invoice totals (e.g. $929.72, $1,394.58) and no clearly stuck fully-paid-but-invoiced record was located. The specific reported WOs are production-only and absent from staging; the bug is explicitly intermittent with an unknown trigger, so it cannot be deterministically reproduced in this harness. Querying /api/invoices/{id}/view with WO ids returns 400 (it expects invoice ids), so per-invoice paid/balance vs status could not be reconciled cheaply.
notes: This is a manual production data-fix / support request for an intermittent, root-cause-unknown condition on specific prod WOs; it is not a deterministic code-fix with a reproducible scenario on disposable staging. No stuck paid-but-invoiced WO was found on staging to reproduce it.
